name: Kotobuki Reiji
source:
The senior of Otoya Ittoki and Tokiya Ichinose. He enjoys giving cute nicknames to his fellow mentors  and also his students. He also always keeps pulling pranks on Ranmaru, whom is the easiest target. Despite all this, he has a very mature side. He plays the maracas.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uta_no_Prince-sama]Wikipedia[/url]]
